title: 9.2 A 400MHz Symbol-Power-Tracking (SPT) Supply Modulator with SPT-Adaptive-Biasing Network Supporting 5G FR2 CMOS PA
problem: 5G NR FR2 (mmWave) power amplifiers suffer from high peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) in OFDM with complex modulations (QAM), causing substantial power consumption at average levels. Envelope tracking (ET) improves efficiency at power back-off but is limited to ~200MHz bandwidth; digital envelope tracking and symbol power tracking (SPT) can exceed this but require robust supply modulation.
motivation: 5G FR2 demands high data rates with OFDM; power efficiency is critical for both base stations and user devices.
method: This system tracks power at the symbol level—each discrete packet of data—rather than following a smooth envelope, enabling much faster response. A 400MHz supply modulator adjusts the voltage delivered to the 5G FR2 CMOS PA based on each symbol's power needs, while an adaptive-biasing network automatically tunes transistor bias in real time to maintain efficiency across varying power demands.
key_novelty: Tracking power at the symbol level instead of the overall envelope enables 400MHz supply modulation for 5G FR2 CMOS power amplifiers.
contributions: SPT-adaptive-biasing network for real-time bias adjustment
Support for high-bandwidth OFDM waveforms with complex modulation
Improved PA efficiency at power back-off
primary_theme: High-bandwidth symbol-power tracking for mmWave PAs
